verdict_word: Light on sales and EPS; Brazil trims the outlook
takeaways: Net sales fell 9% to $1.59 billion; volume slipped 2% and pricing dropped 7%, per the company release.
Pricing pressure came from older molecules in Brazil and from U.S. acetochlor; Latin America organic sales fell 31%, while North America organic sales grew 7%.
Pro forma GAAP loss from continuing operations was $54 million, or $(0.08) a share, versus a $60 million profit a year earlier.
Corteva updated full-year 2026 guidance to $1.1-$1.125 billion operating EBITDA and $0.76-$0.80 operating EPS, citing weaker Brazil conditions.
The board authorized the first common dividend since the seed-business spin.
verdict: The first report since the seed split came in soft, with Brazil pricing doing most of the damage. North America grew, which is nice, but the guide was the part with a haircut.
